basis: Imports below this over the regime window count as not arriving, if thermal is also high (see import_cutoff_thermal_share). Imports ran below 1 GWh/day before 68 of the 99 monthly origins since 2018, mostly in wet months, so the cutoff is not read from imports alone

Thermal at or above this share of its demonstrated ceiling while imports are below the cutoff separates 'not available' from 'not needed'. The same 4 historical origins are picked out anywhere from 0.60 to 0.75, so the line is not a tuned one
Trailing window the import regime is read over, ending at the origin; at least half of it must be usable days

Cut between the ajustado and deficit tiers: about 5% of 2026 demand and roughly an hour of national consumption. The 2024 episode ran at a measured suppression of 20 to 25 GWh/day, four to five times this
Trailing window the demonstrated thermal and import ceilings are taken over. The whole record would put thermal at 30.69 GWh/day on 2016-12-27, from a fleet since partly retired
